'''Sarrissa Jeng''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] at a young age, Sarrissa Jeng was given to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for induction within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi academy|academy]]. [[Jedi training/Legends|Trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Jeng eventually [[Initiate Trials/Legends|graduated]] and was selected as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] by a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Eventually building herself a blue-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and passing her [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]], Jeng was made a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="DBSJ" />

Active during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], a growing division between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Jedi Jeng was dispatched as the leader of a six-member Jedi task force to the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] colony world [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]]. There, Jeng and her team of [[Jedi Diplomat|diplomats]] were to negotiate the release of Emissary [[Nathanjo Nirrelz]], a Gotal representative [[Gotal hostage standoff|taken hostage]] by the [[Roshu Sune/Legends|Roshu Sune]] during the [[Battle of Antar 4 (Separatist Crisis)|battle]] of [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]]. During the negotiations, a group of unaffiliated vigilantes opened fire on the Roshu Shone guerrillas. This attack panicked the Gotal Roshu Shone, who opened fire on their captives. Leaping to defend the unarmed hostages, Jeng and her fellow Jedi managed to subdue the guerrillas on their [[Passenger liner/Legends|commuter hopper]], but not before Jedi [[Kaloor Cofi]] and [[Antyard-Wo Shissan]] lost their lives. Emerging from the firefight, Jedi Jeng and a [[Unidentified Mon Calamari Jedi Knight|Mon Calamari Jedi Knight]] escorted Emissary Nirrelz to safety while the other Jedi helped transport the surviving hostages to [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenters]] in the nearby cities of [[Skreeka]] and [[Talos (spaceport)|Talos]].<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|jediwatch/13425_1.html|Gotal Standoff Ends Violently}}</ref>

[[File:Sarrissa.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Sarrissa Jeng on Atzerri.]]
After the fighting ended, the surviving Jedi departed for [[Aleen Minor/Legends|Aleen Minor]] and the [[Jedi chapter house (Aleen Minor)|Order's chapter house]] there for the [[Jedi funeral/Legends|funerals]] of Jedi Cofi and Shissan. Meanwhile across the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] network, the Jedi were heavily criticized by [[Gotal Foreign Affairs Commune]] leader [[Shagrad Loset]] for what he saw as meddling in an internal affair. Rebuffing this assault on the Order, Jedi Master and High Council member [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] commended the Jedi effort on Atzerri.<ref name="DBSJ" />

It wasn't long before tensions between the Confederacy and the Republic came to a head. When the Confederacy captured Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] assembled all available Jedi in a massive [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]]. Stationed at the Coruscant Temple at the time, Jeng answered Master Windu's call and departed for the Separatist foundry world, Geonosis, with 200 of her colleagues. Landing on the dusty plains of Geonosis, Jeng and her comrades stormed the [[Petranaki arena]] and engaged the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] on the arena floor, with Jeng herself dispatching a Geonosian warrior with a loud battle cry. Unfortunately, Jeng was ultimately overwhelmed and killed.<ref name="DBSJ" /><ref name="Fightsaber">{{SWArchive|url=games/videogames/news20080728.html|text=Fightsaber: Mastering the Art of Lightsaber Combat}}</ref>

==Powers and abilities==
Sarrissa Jeng wielded a blue-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and was a practitioner of [[Form VI/Legends|Form VI: Niman]]. While a skilled warrior, she perished in the Battle of Geonosis due to her preferred style not being able to cope with the sheer number of opponents.<ref name="Fightsaber" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sarrissa Jeng was portrayed by [[Karen Wilson]], a student of [[Wikipedia:Byron Bay, New South Wales|Byron Bay]] [[Wikipedia:Kendo|Kendo]] Club.

In a behind the scenes cut that never made the movie, Sarrissa's body can be seen. There is a video titled "Raid on the Droid Control Ship." It is at the end of this video that Sarrissa's body can be seen.

A Sarissa Jeng action figure was due for release as part of a Geonosis 4-figure Multipack for the end of 2013.<ref>{{Rebelscum|url=story/front/Hasbro_Two_New_MultiPacks_Revealed_153618.asp|text=Hasbro: Two New Multi-Packs Revealed}}</ref>
